mapper.select: SELECT task_id AS taskId, source_event_sha256 AS sourceEventSha256 FROM lbl_label_task WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND source_event_key = #{sourceEventKey} LIMIT 1

SELECT t.task_id AS taskId, t.source_event_key AS sourceEventKey, t.source_event_type AS sourceEventType, t.source_price_book_id AS sourcePriceBookId, t.source_price_version AS sourcePriceVersion, t.store_id AS storeId, t.store_name AS storeName, t.effective_at AS effectiveAt, t.state, COUNT(i.item_id) AS itemCount, SUM(i.state IN ('PENDING','PREVIEW_READY')) AS pendingCount, SUM(i.state = 'EXCEPTION') AS exceptionCount, t.created_at AS createdAt, t.version FROM lbl_label_task t JOIN lbl_label_task_item i ON i.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND i.task_id = t.task_id WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.store_id IN #{storeId} AND t.state = #{state} GROUP BY t.task_id, t.source_event_key, t.source_event_type, t.source_price_book_id, t.source_price_version, t.store_id, t.store_name, t.effective_at, t.state, t.created_at, t.version ORDER BY t.effective_at DESC, t.task_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.task_id AS taskId, t.source_event_key AS sourceEventKey, t.source_event_type AS sourceEventType, t.source_price_book_id AS sourcePriceBookId, t.source_price_version AS sourcePriceVersion, t.store_id AS storeId, t.store_name AS storeName, t.effective_at AS effectiveAt, t.state, COUNT(i.item_id) AS itemCount, SUM(i.state IN ('PENDING','PREVIEW_READY')) AS pendingCount, SUM(i.state = 'EXCEPTION') AS exceptionCount, t.created_at AS createdAt, t.version FROM lbl_label_task t LEFT JOIN lbl_label_task_item i ON i.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND i.task_id = t.task_id WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.task_id = #{taskId} GROUP BY t.task_id, t.source_event_key, t.source_event_type, t.source_price_book_id, t.source_price_version, t.store_id, t.store_name, t.effective_at, t.state, t.created_at, t.version
mapper.update: UPDATE lbl_label_task SET state = 'DISPATCH_BLOCKED', updated_at = #{updatedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND version = #{version} AND state NOT IN ('COMPLETED','SUPERSEDED')

UPDATE lbl_label_task t SET t.state = ( SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(i.state = 'EXCEPTION') > 0 THEN 'EXCEPTION' WHEN SUM(i.state = 'REPLACED_CONFIRMED') + SUM(i.state = 'SUPERSEDED') = COUNT(*) THEN CASE WHEN SUM(i.state = 'REPLACED_CONFIRMED') > 0 THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE 'SUPERSEDED' END WHEN SUM(i.state = 'REPLACED_CONFIRMED') > 0 THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' WHEN SUM(i.state = 'PREVIEW_READY') + SUM(i.state = 'SUPERSEDED') = COUNT(*) THEN 'PREVIEW_READY' ELSE 'PENDING' END FROM lbl_label_task_item i WHERE i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND i.task_id = #{taskId} ), t.updated_at = #{updatedAt}, t.version = t.version + 1 WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.task_id = #{taskId}
